text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the moment you've all been waiting
for—the
Mainichi Okan is about to
begin! The racers are
itching to test their
chops before the autumn
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, with this level of hype, you'd
think the
crowd was here for a G1 race.
Guess everyone's
really been looking
forward to this.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
There's Mejiro Ardan, Oguri Cap, even
Inari
One... Powerhouses as far as the
eye can see.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Especially Oguri Cap and Inari One.
Since they're
part of...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The Eternal Top Three.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, Creek, and Inari. Recently, more
and more
people have been referring to
them collectively
as such.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Three shining stars whose tale will be
told for all
eternity. It's as if that title
serves as proof of the
status they've
been promised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It's a title very much worthy of
overturning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, perhaps you're onto something
there. After
all, we are out to pulverize
countless dreams.
choice_data_list: まるで悪者の台詞だな
まるで悪者の台詞だね
choice_data_list_en: You sound just like a villain.
You sound just like a villain, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I simply felt like saying that. It rolls off
the
tongue surprisingly nicely, doesn't
it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan seems to have grown
somewhat
mischievous over the past
three years. I wonder
what her nanny
would have to say about that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well... I shall be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I shall follow through on my
word,
and leave a lasting impression of
all that I'm
capable of in this moment.
choice_data_list: 出し惜しみはしなくていいからな！
出し惜しみはしなくていいからね！
choice_data_list_en: No need to hold anything back, okay!
No need to hold anything back, okay!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, look who's here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oguri, Inari...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe, it's rather impressive seeing them
up close.
I can see that they're both in
tip-top condition.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right then, you two. Let's go ahead and
make this
one a race to remember... Of
course, it goes
without saying I'm going
to be the star of this
show.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm well aware of both your strengths.
Neither of
you are taking my win,
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shan't be handing anyone victory on a
silver
platter myself either. I mean to
compete with my
all... and to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Here I go... Time to take my position as
one of
the greats!)
